Synthetic fixtures created for this snapshot, no personal or third-party data. `tone.wav`, `tone.flac`, `tone.mp3`, `tone.ogg`, `tone.m4a` and `tone.aiff` are 0.25-second 440 Hz test tones generated from FFmpeg's `sine` source at 48 kHz. They verify local decoder routing only; they are not speech-quality or playback-device references. Use them for development and regression tests. Proposed project license applies. No test output is claimed until run.
